references.text: The description of the peace offering (שְׁלָמִים) and its regulations, which form the basis for the peace offering mentioned in Num 7:29
Detailed instructions on how to bring a peace offering before the Lord
The same offering formula used by Nahshon son of Amminadab, showing the recurring pattern in the offerings of the tribal leaders
The same offering formula used by Nethanel son of Zuar, confirming the standardized offering pattern
The same offering formula used by Elizur son of Shedeur, continuing the recurring pattern
Eliab son of Helon is mentioned as leader of the tribe of Zebulun, the same person who brings the offering in Num 7:29
Eliab son of Helon identified as prince over the tribe of Zebulun in the camp arrangement
Peace offerings were also brought at the covenant ceremony at Sinai, showing the significance of the offering in Israel's worship
